shellCommands.command: sed -n 1620,1660p /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts; echo ---; grep -rn "prefetch" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/build/segment-config/app/app-segment-config.js 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rln "const prefetch" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/build/segment-config/ 2>/dev/null

echo "== default prefetch (shell) =="; curl -s http://localhost:3000/product -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' | grep -c "Compact Widget"; echo "== navigation RSC request =="; curl -s http://localhost:3000/product -H 'RSC: 1' | grep -c "Compact Widget"; echo "== segment prefetch tree =="; curl -s http://localhost:3000/product -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /_tree' | head -c 500; echo
curl -s http://localhost:3000/product -H 'RSC: 1' | head -c 3000; echo; echo "===HTML==="; curl -s http://localhost:3000/product | grep -o "Compact Widget" | head -2

curl -s -D- -o /tmp/rsc.out http://localhost:3000/product -H 'RSC: 1' | head -20; echo "--- body bytes: $(wc -c < /tmp/rsc.out)"; curl -s -D- -o /tmp/pf.out http://localhost:3000/product -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' | head -20; echo "--- prefetch body bytes: $(wc -c < /tmp/pf.out)"

echo "== full/static prefetch payload =="; curl -sL 'http://localhost:3000/product?_rsc=HEAvJdHAQJrUAe2K' -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' > /tmp/pf.out; wc -c /tmp/pf.out; grep -c "Compact Widget" /tmp/pf.out || true; echo "== segment-prefetch shell (default) =="; for seg in "/_tree" "/" "/product" "/_index"; do printf "%s: " "$seg"; curl -sL "http://localhost:3000/product?_rsc=1" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H "Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: $seg" | tee /tmp/seg.out | wc -c; grep -c "Compact Widget" /tmp/seg.out || true; done

echo "== __PAGE__ segment (default prefetch payload) =="; grep -c "Compact Widget" /workspace/.next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc || echo "not present"; echo "== _full segment (full prefetch / prefetch=true) =="; grep -c "Compact Widget" /workspace/.next/server/app/product.segments/_full.segment.rsc || echo "not present"; echo "== served page segment =="; curl -sL "http://localhost:3000/product?_rsc=1" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /product/__PAGE__' | tee /tmp/page.seg | grep -c "Compact Widget" || echo "not present"; wc -c /tmp/page.seg

cat /workspace/.next/server/app/product.meta | python3 -m json.tool 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo ===; grep -c "Compact Widget" /workspace/.next/server/app/product.rsc; grep -o "unstable_prefetch\|PrefetchStatic\|staticLinkData" /workspace/.next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc | sort | uniq -c

grep -rn "shellLength\|staleIfError\|sliceStream\|shellBoundary\|3018" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/streaming-metadata.js 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rln "segment.rsc\|segmentPrefetch" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/*.js | head; echo ===; grep -rn "NEXT_ROUTER_SEGMENT_PREFETCH_HEADER\|Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-headers.js

cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-headers.js | grep -n "const NEXT" ; echo ===; grep -rn "shell\|slice\|stage" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/base-server.js | grep -in "segment" | head -15
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; git -C /workspace status --short
git -C /workspace status --short; git -C /workspace diff -- tsconfig.json | head -30
